d: Bihar ki rajniti men dhanteras par tejasvi yadav dvara kharidi gaee 80 lakh rupye ki gari ko lekar shuru huaa vivad ab behad aakramak mor le chuka hai. jediyu (JDU) ke varishth neta niraj kumar dvara uthae gae savalon par rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke mukhy pravaktaon men se ek bantu sinh ne karara palatvar karte hue endie sarkar ki nakamiyon ki pol kholi hai.
